sources.fact: LBBD50/YC Royal British Legion/Jervis Court is 0.37ha, 64 net dwellings, public-authority ownership category, not-permissioned; notes state permission 20/01352/FULL has lapsed.
Planning Committee considered exact application 20/01352/FUL for demolition and 64 residential units at 1-18 Jervis Court/Rectory Road and delegated grant subject to S106/time conditions.
Cabinet approved in principle comprehensive redevelopment of the former Royal British Legion site and Jervis Court, establishing programme provenance rather than title or current consent.
Council records resident consultation and redevelopment decisions for Jervis Court; these governance steps do not substitute for a live planning permission.

February 2026 Cabinet approved a decant/replacement-homes strategy using Jervis Court/former British Legion and Brockelbank Lodge sites, with approximately 157 replacement social rented homes across the programme.
The 2026 decision authorises programme, vacant-possession, funding and appropriation steps but explicitly anticipates planning permission being secured; it is not a replacement planning consent.
Planning Data brownfield land is authoritative-source register evidence used for current status/capacity checks; register status is kept distinct from planning decisions.
Planning Data API supports structured entity/spatial discovery; absence or point geometry is not used to manufacture exact site/title relations.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 is adopted policy context; allocation/programme status does not grant permission.
Case-specific current status requires exact planning application/decision evidence.
LBBD states brownfield register sites still require planning permission.
Development-plan and regeneration-programme evidence guides decisions but does not prove legal title or current consent.
